d: Japan is planning to spend 56.3 trillion yen ($353 billion) on defence over the next five years. That is a 31 per cent increase over its current budget. But the proposed figure is far below the 80 trillion yen ($502 billion) that Japan’s defence officials had hoped for. With concerns over military equipment orders, rising import costs and pressure from Washington to spend more, Tokyo faces a difficult balancing act. Why is Japan holding back? And can it afford the military build-up it wants?
